//! @generated — backend Skia: kanvas 2D nyata, hasil akhir tetap `Frame`.

use super::font;
use super::{Backend, DrawCmd, DrawList, RenderError, Renderer};
use crate::core::{Align, Color, Frame, Rect, Size};
use skia_safe::{AlphaType, Color4f, ColorType, Data, ImageInfo, Paint, Rect as SkRect, Surface};

#[derive(Debug, Default)]
pub struct SkiaRenderer {
    surface: Option<Surface>,
}

impl SkiaRenderer {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self::default()
    }

    fn canvas(&mut self) -> Result<&skia_safe::Canvas, RenderError> {
        self.surface
            .as_mut()
            .map(Surface::canvas)
            .ok_or_else(|| RenderError::Message("Skia surface is not ready".into()))
    }
}

fn paint(color: Color, opacity: f32) -> Paint {
    let alpha = (f32::from(color.a) / 255.0 * opacity.clamp(0.0, 1.0)).clamp(0.0, 1.0);
    Paint::new(
        Color4f::new(
            f32::from(color.r) / 255.0,
            f32::from(color.g) / 255.0,
            f32::from(color.b) / 255.0,
            alpha,
        ),
        None,
    )
}

fn sk_rect(rect: Rect) -> SkRect {
    SkRect::new(
        rect.left(),
        rect.top(),
        rect.right(),
        rect.bottom(),
    )
}

fn radius(rect: Rect, value: f32) -> f32 {
    value.max(0.0).min(rect.size.width.min(rect.size.height) / 2.0)
}

impl Renderer for SkiaRenderer {
    fn kind(&self) -> Backend {
        Backend::Skia
    }

    fn render(&mut self, list: &DrawList, size: Size) -> Result<Frame, RenderError> {
        let size = size.clamped();
        let width = size.width as i32;
        let height = size.height as i32;
        let info = ImageInfo::new((width, height), ColorType::RGBA8888, AlphaType::Premul, None);
        let mut surface = skia_safe::surfaces::raster(&info, None, None)
            .ok_or_else(|| RenderError::Message("could not create a Skia surface".into()))?;
        surface.canvas().clear(Color4f::new(0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0));

        for command in &list.commands {
            match command {
                DrawCmd::Rect { rect, fill, radius: corner, opacity } => {
                    let p = paint(*fill, *opacity);
                    let r = radius(*rect, *corner);
                    if r > 0.0 {
                        surface.canvas().draw_round_rect(sk_rect(*rect), r, r, &p);
                    } else {
                        surface.canvas().draw_rect(sk_rect(*rect), &p);
                    }
                }
                DrawCmd::StrokeRect { rect, stroke, width, radius: corner } => {
                    let mut p = paint(*stroke, 1.0);
                    p.set_stroke(true);
                    p.set_stroke_width(width.max(1.0));
                    let r = radius(*rect, *corner);
                    if r > 0.0 {
                        surface.canvas().draw_round_rect(sk_rect(*rect), r, r, &p);
                    } else {
                        surface.canvas().draw_rect(sk_rect(*rect), &p);
                    }
                }
                DrawCmd::Ellipse { rect, fill, opacity } => {
                    surface.canvas().draw_oval(sk_rect(*rect), &paint(*fill, *opacity));
                }
                DrawCmd::Line { from, to, stroke, width } => {
                    let mut p = paint(*stroke, 1.0);
                    p.set_stroke(true);
                    p.set_stroke_width(width.max(1.0));
                    surface.canvas().draw_line((from.x, from.y), (to.x, to.y), &p);
                }
                DrawCmd::Text { rect, text, size, color, bold: _, align } => {
                    let scale = font::scale_for(*size);
                    let text_width = font::measure(text, scale) as f32;
                    let x = match align {
                        Align::Start => rect.left(),
                        Align::Center => rect.left() + (rect.size.width - text_width) / 2.0,
                        Align::End => rect.right() - text_width,
                    };
                    let glyph_height = (7 * scale) as f32;
                    let y = rect.top() + (rect.size.height - glyph_height).max(0.0) / 2.0;
                    let p = paint(*color, 1.0);
                    for (px, py) in font::rasterize(text, scale) {
                        let left = x + px as f32;
                        let top = y + py as f32;
                        surface.canvas().draw_rect(SkRect::new(left, top, left + 1.0, top + 1.0), &p);
                    }
                }
                DrawCmd::Image { rect, bytes } => {
                    let mut codec = skia_safe::Codec::from_data(Data::new_copy(bytes))
                        .ok_or_else(|| RenderError::Message("could not decode an image asset".into()))?;
                    let image = codec
                        .get_image(None, None)
                        .map_err(|_| RenderError::Message("could not decode an image asset".into()))?;
                    surface.canvas().draw_image_rect(
                        image,
                        None,
                        sk_rect(*rect),
                        &paint(Color::WHITE, 1.0),
                    );
                }
            }
        }

        let mut frame = Frame::new(size);
        let read_info = ImageInfo::new((width, height), ColorType::RGBA8888, AlphaType::Unpremul, None);
        let row_bytes = width as usize * 4;
        if !surface.read_pixels(&read_info, &mut frame.pixels, row_bytes, (0, 0)) {
            return Err(RenderError::Message("Skia pixel readback failed".into()));
        }
        self.surface = Some(surface);
        Ok(frame)
    }
}
